child_article_legal_issues.wrong_claim: H1 « 50cc au Vietnam : la cylindrée qui se conduit sans permis » and meta « Non, un 50cc se conduit sans permis au Vietnam selon la règle en vigueur » (blanket exemption)
child_article_legal_issues.correct_statement: Only a xe gắn máy (≤ 50 cm3 AND design speed ≤ 50 km/h; electric ≤ 4 kW) is exempt from the driving licence (Law 36/2024 art. 34(1)(g), 56(1),(4)); the rider must be ≥ 16 (art. 59(1)(a)), know the rules and have riding skills; helmet (art. 33(2)), zero alcohol (art. 9(2)), registration and compulsory insurance papers (art. 56(1)) still apply; a vehicle outside the definition is a xe mô tô requiring A1.

child_article_legal_issues.wrong_claim: H1 « Scooter électrique au Vietnam : quand aucun permis n'est exigé » presented as a general rule
child_article_legal_issues.correct_statement: No licence only for an electric xe gắn máy (motor ≤ 4 kW and design speed ≤ 50 km/h, rider ≥ 16) or a pedal-assist xe đạp máy (assistance cut at 25 km/h); electric two-wheelers up to 11 kW need A1 and above 11 kW need A (Law 36/2024 arts 34, 56, 57, 59).

child_article_legal_issues.wrong_claim: Low-power electrics « autour de 4 kW … vitesse bridée autour de 50 km/h — se rangent du côté des vélos assistés et cyclomoteurs »
child_article_legal_issues.correct_statement: Electric ≤ 4 kW and ≤ 50 km/h by design is a xe gắn máy (moped, motor vehicle, art. 34(1)(g)); the assisted bicycle (xe đạp máy, assistance cut at 25 km/h) is a separate non-motorised class (art. 34(2)(b)); thresholds are ceilings (« au plus »), not approximations.

new_meta.title: Sécurité à moto au Vietnam : Hanoi, pluie, montagne et accident
new_meta.description: Priorités et klaxon à Hanoi, casque conforme, nuit, pluie, cols de Ha Giang et Sapa, passager et gestes après un accident : les règles et conseils à connaître.

evidence.FACTS: Legal points from Law 36: keep right/lane change (art 13), turning and U-turn bans (art 15), lights 18–6 h and dipped beam (art 20), horn only for danger/overtaking, none 22–5 h in populated areas (art 21), priorities incl. roundabout yield to left / unsigned yield to right (art 22), no cao tốc for motorbikes (art 25(3)), slow down in rain/fog/passes/livestock (art 12), one passenger + exceptions, helmet, load limits 0.3/0.5/2 m (art 33), accident duties (art 80), fleeing prohibited (art 9). Helmet standard QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN + CR (seen). Emergency 113/114/115 and 112 (seen, cited separately). No speed figures, no rainy-season months, no route conditions asserted.
